decision.owner: Repository owner Yes on the narrow contract-evolution policy amendment, 2026-10-15; applied here by the coordinator after independent review
decision.reference: Authorization bead bu-4ijka2 for implementation bead bu-q7vx1q.80 (Baselines S5: work and sleep lane balance is judged against the owner personal baseline band from the shared core scorer, with a median baseline, a uniform one-hour minimum band half-width and an inclusive band edge, instead of the 7-day mean ratio). Reviewed before: main 7cbcbfa13faa1fbe593d6a0fbb57555adeeed888 as recorded in bu-q7vx1q.80 (contract-review-lane local verdict CLEAN-pending-CE; the formal review bead opens with the DRAFT PR while GitHub access is suspended); approved subject: agent/bu-q7vx1q.80 head 2582ea61a4c5169583d30a471309f7e2b698b2b4 plus the reviewer-computed clause commit (spec-clause.patch) and request. Governing requirements REQ-chronicler-api-013 (Daily Balance Endpoint) and REQ-chronicler-api-014 (Trends Endpoint) in openspec/specs/chronicler-api/spec.md, whose ID-only headers land in this same change; the PR appends one scenario to each block. The 26 owners in tests/chronicler/test_balance.py, tests/chronicler/test_balance_trends_api.py and roster/chronicler/tests/test_writeback.py move from mean-ratio pins to the baseline band. This exact manifest requires its own independent review and protected-main publication before consumption; provenance text grants no runtime admission.

The superseded contract made a lane's usual a trailing mean and flagged an anomaly past max(3600 s, half the mean) after seven samples. The rewritten case runs the same intent through compute_daily_balance over dated per-day samples and asserts the personal-baseline band instead: median center, observed-day count, state and insufficient_history.

The superseded contract exempted an 8 h lane's one-hour swing through a relative floor (half the mean). The band has no relative floor: its half-width is max(3 scaled MADs, one hour), and one hour is the inclusive edge. The case keeps its intent, a small swing on a large flat baseline reads within, with a 30-minute swing.
